_comment: Per-castaway prior features. All values 0..1 unless noted.
phys    = physical/challenge value. High phys lowers pre-merge boot risk, RAISES post-merge risk.
social  = read-people / bond-building proxy. High social lowers boot risk everywhere.
threat  = perceived strategic or winner threat. Mildly lowers pre-merge risk, raises post-merge risk.
phys/social/threat are SUBJECTIVE pre-season priors from bio data only (age + occupation). Weak.
preseason_buzz = -1..1, same sign convention as the in-season 'edit' signal (+ = doomed-looking,
- = protected/favoured). Unlike phys/social/threat this is NOT a bio guess - it is read from
named, dated, cited pre-season predictions, checked 2026-09-17:
- Idol Speculation, 'Survivor 51 Cast Assessment', 2026-08-28
https://idolspeculation.wordpress.com/2026/08/28/idol-speculation-survivor-51-cast-assessment/
One blogger's full-cast assessment: winner picks (Aaliyah primary, Devin second, Sharonda
dark horse), a named first-boot pick (Linnea), a pre-merge-boot list (11 names), and
deep-run/finale picks (Ana, Kilby, Carter, Eric, Ori, Patt).
- Yahoo, 'Who's most likely to win Survivor 51 based on their occupation?', checked 2026-09-17
https://www.yahoo.com/entertainment/tv/articles/whos-most-likely-win-survivor-224931211.html
Cites historical winner-occupation data favouring business/medical/police/fire roles; names
Cristian (HR) and Mike (baseball ops exec) as having a stronger-than-average occupational profile.
No Survivor 51 prediction-market (Polymarket/Kalshi) odds exist yet as of 2026-09-17 - those sites
only had markets for already-aired seasons (48-50). Checked and confirmed absent, not just unchecked.
Treat preseason_buzz as ONE source's pre-season opinion, not knowledge: it is deliberately capped at
+-0.30, well inside the +-1.0 range 'edit' uses for real in-episode evidence, and it should be the
first thing overwritten once real edit signals exist after episode 1 - see docs/PLAYBOOK.md.
Episode edit data overwrites all of this - see docs/PLAYBOOK.md. Do not treat any of it as knowledge.

weights._comment: Hazard weights. Positive weight => feature RAISES boot risk.
